resolved_requests.decision_topic: What does Crystal Synthesizer advance next, now that siblings are using it as a source?
resolved_requests.steward_recommendation: PROVE-BIREFRINGENCE — smallest deliverable that directly tests the optical claim the vector hangs on; the ruby doublet recipe is already in the Sonification Reference.

resolved_requests.decision_topic: Where does the optical-acoustic bridge go next, now that birefringence is proven?
resolved_requests.steward_recommendation: DISPERSION-FILTER — the optical-acoustic vector names three phenomena; birefringence is done, and dispersion is the conceptually deepest of the two remaining because it lives in the time domain, not the frequency domain. Same physics, different observational projection — and the prism analogy lands hardest when arrival times separate the way wavelengths do.
